hint.sample: Appears on the building-naming dice button.

building_panel.mock_note: love=123, round=7; first-wins union of the five per-mode views ('unlock', 'construct', 'upgrade', 'base_info', 'preview') for ids shared across modes (panel/close_btn) — see views.<name>.mock_note for that mode's own mock state

base_info.mock_note: love=123, round=7; the base tile (the hole)

construct.mock_note: love=123, round=7; the lowest-(row,col) BUILDABLE tile of the 'first_light' map — construct cards are dynamic-count and deliberately un-id'd, they inherit defaults.button_skin

preview.mock_note: love=123, round=7; ConstructPreview('defence') modal open over the construct panel, count=1, tier_idx=0 (preview_cancel_btn present iff ui.Timing.construct_show_cancel)

unlock.mock_note: love=123, round=7; the lowest-(row,col) COMBAT tile of the 'first_light' map, its real 2x2 chunk and unlock cost

upgrade.mock_note: love=123, round=7; a freshly created 'defence' building (tier 0, level 1) — upgrade_gate resolves 'in_tier' deterministically

enemy_intro.mock_note: love=123, round=7 (mock entry; open(), settled at rest)

game_log.mock_note: love=123, round=7 (empty log, no messages queued)

levelup.mock_note: love=123, round=7 (backdrop only — the 1-3 option boxes are dynamic-count content, not individually overridable)

overlays.mock_note: love=123, round=7 (idle, no world state — the two toggle pills)

settings.mock_note: love=123, round=7 (idle, default SessionSettings — no world state)
